scope: Research only; no null INF or device policy deployed
observations: Microsoft documents a null INF for unused devices without a function driver. It leaves the devnode enumerated and may reserve boot resources. This does not implement the device.
Owned Windows 2000 display.inf, usb.inf, netirsir.inf and ntprint.inf contain null AddService forms. Thus this syntax exists in the owned OS, not just modern documentation.
No such package is used in cases001-003; the emulator device and unsupported-driver condition remain intact. Avoid using a policy change as evidence that the original shutdown race is fixed.
